items.title: UK ban on goods from Israeli settlements 'evidence of Netanyahu's failure'
items.standfirst: British foreign minister Ed Miliband accused the Israeli government on Tuesday of turning a "blind eye" to what he called "ethnic cleansing" by settlers in the West Bank. Miliband told parliament the UK government would introduce "an import ban on goods from illegal settlements in the occupied territories", in a move coordinated with other countries. Jordana Miller, ABC correspondent in Jerusalem, told France 24 that the ban was evidence of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to rein in the far-right elements of his government that has facilitated the growth of settlements.

items.title: Trump posts AI map showing US 'takeover' of North America, Iceland and Caribbean
items.standfirst: Donald Trump shared an AI-generated map Monday appearing to show the US absorbing Canada, Mexico, Greenland, Iceland, Cuba and parts of the Caribbean into a giant “United States of America”. Online, the map has triggered widespread ridicule and questions about Trump’s fitness for office.
